mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.customer_id, f.sku_id, p.name AS product_name, s.sku_code, s.spec_name, s.spec_values, s.sale_unit, s.market_price, (SELECT i.locked_unit_price FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = f.last_order_id AND i.sku_id = f.sku_id AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id LIMIT 1) AS last_unit_price, (SELECT i.ordered_quantity FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = f.last_order_id AND i.sku_id = f.sku_id AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id LIMIT 1) AS last_quantity, f.buy_count, f.last_order_id, f.last_ordered_at FROM marketing_frequent_sku f LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = f.sku_id AND s.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE f.deleted = FALSE AND f.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY f.buy_count DESC, f.last_ordered_at DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT sku_id, product_name_snapshot AS product_name, sku_code_snapshot AS sku_code, spec_name_snapshot AS spec_name, sale_unit_snapshot AS sale_unit, ordered_quantity AS quantity, locked_unit_price AS unit_price FROM sales_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY sort_order, id
